# Frontmatter reference

Every key brick reads from a file's YAML frontmatter, the block between `---` lines at the top of a page, layout or component. Nothing here is required: `<h1>Hello</h1>` with no frontmatter is a complete page.

The keys, value shapes and descriptions are generated from `brick.FrontmatterSchema()`, the JSON Schema that `brick schema` prints for editors. That schema is built from the key lists the engine parses, so this page lists exactly the keys the engine accepts. The schema checks one file's shape; what needs more than one file (a `load:` function that exists, a host's `Options.PropTypes`) is checked by `brick check`.

Point an editor at the schema with `brick schema -o .vscode/brick-frontmatter.schema.json` for completion and hover text while typing.

## Top-level keys

Written at the top of the frontmatter. Any other top-level key is the file's own data, read as `.Params.<key>` on a page (and as `.Props` on a layout).

| Key | Value | Applies to | Default | What it does | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brick` | map of settings | any file | none | Engine settings added after the top-level keys were frozen (A13). | [brick: settings](#brick-settings) |
| `cache` | map of settings | page | none | Cache settings. Only tags is accepted; the rest is reserved for the cache phase. | [The guide](../guide.md#a-whole-site--urls-serving-building) |
| `client` | any value | reserved | — | Reserved engine key (A13); the engine does not read it. A prop is sent to the browser with props: {name: {client: true}}. | [Styles and client code](../guides/components/styles-and-client.md) |
| `dedent` | bool | component | `true` | Strip the common leading indentation of the body (default true). | [Children, blocks and slots](../guides/components/slots.md) |
| `inject` | map of map of settings | component | none | Context keys this component reads from an ancestor's provide:, key → {default, required} (or bare for neither). | [Layouts and data](../guides/components/layouts-and-data.md) |
| `layout` | text | page, layout | `layouts/default.html` when it exists, else none | The layout this page renders inside: a layout name, a ~/ path, or none. | [Layouts and data](../guides/components/layouts-and-data.md) |
| `load` | text | any file | none | The script function that loads this file's data (posts.recent, or an inline &lt;brick:script&gt; function). It receives props, page and the injected context and returns a dict. | [Scripts and loaders](../guides/components/loaders.md) |
| `passthrough` | list of text | any file | `Options.Passthrough` | Tag names written out as plain HTML even though they look like components. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md#step-6--choose-how-a-files-tags-are-read) |
| `props` | map of (text, or map of settings) | component | none (undeclared props still pass through) | The props a component takes, name → a type (`title: string`) or a declaration {type, default, required, oneof, client, reactive, doc, examples}. children and key are reserved. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `provide` | map | any file | none | Context values this file provides to every component below it, key → value. A component reads one by declaring it in inject:. | [Layouts and data](../guides/components/layouts-and-data.md) |
| `raw` | bool | component | `false` | true renders the body as-is: no component tags, no {{ }} actions. | [Children, blocks and slots](../guides/components/slots.md) |
| `state` | map | stateful component | none (not stateful) | A stateful component's initial state, field → value. A stateful component is always an island and its actions change this state. | [The guide](../guide.md#actions--a-button-that-changes-server-state) |
| `strictParams` | bool | page | `Options.StrictParams` (`false`) | true makes a .Params lookup of a key the frontmatter does not set an error, instead of an empty value. Unset uses the engine's default. | [Layouts and data](../guides/components/layouts-and-data.md) |
| `strictProps` | bool | component | `false` | true makes passing a prop this component does not declare an error. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `syntax` | `both` · `capitalized` · `hyphenated` | any file | `Options.Syntax` (`both`) | Which tag spellings this file accepts: capitalized (&lt;Card&gt;), hyphenated (&lt;x-card&gt;) or both. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md#step-6--choose-how-a-files-tags-are-read) |
| `unknown` | `error` · `passthrough` | any file | `Options.Unknown` (`error`) | What an unknown tag means here: error, or passthrough (written out as plain HTML). | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md#step-6--choose-how-a-files-tags-are-read) |
| `use` | map of text | any file | none | Imports, name → ~/ path: a component (.html), data (.json .yaml .yml .toml) or script (.star) file, or a remote import. A component name starts with an uppercase letter. | [Scripts and loaders](../guides/components/loaders.md) |

## brick: settings

Written under one `brick:` map. `brick:` holds the settings added after the top-level keys were frozen; an unknown key in it is a warning naming the known ones.

| Key | Value | Applies to | Default | What it does | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brick.css` | `global` · `scoped` · `inclusive` | component | `global` | How the component's sibling stylesheet (Card.css next to Card.html) ships: global (default), scoped or inclusive, as with &lt;brick:style scoped&gt;. | [Styles and client code](../guides/components/styles-and-client.md) |
| `brick.init` | script function (`fn` or `ns.fn`) | stateful component | none | Script function that seeds a new instance's state (fn or ns.fn). | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.island` | bool | component | `false` | true makes this component an island: rendered per request by Engine.Fill, never inside the cached page. | [The guide](../guide.md#islands--per-request-parts-of-a-cached-page) |
| `brick.lazy` | `load` · `visible` · `idle` · `stream` | component | none (the call site's `brick:lazy`) | This component's default lazy mode; a call site's brick:lazy wins. | [The guide](../guide.md#lazy-islands-and-streamed-replies) |
| `brick.listen` | text, or list of text, or map of settings | stateful component | none | Topics this stateful component refreshes on (server push, needs Options.Push): a topic, a list, or {topics, keep_alive, presence}. A topic may use {{ .Props.x }} and {{ .State.x }}. | [The guide](../guide.md#server-push--live-updates-from-elsewhere) |
| `brick.load_many` | text | component | none | The batch loader: one call per render level gets every distinct input of this component's calls. Replaces load: on this file. | [Scripts and loaders](../guides/components/loaders.md) |
| `brick.lock_state` | bool | stateful component | `Options.LockState` | true closes this component's state to the client except the writable: fields (and upload and query fields); false keeps it open when Options.LockState closes every component. | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.locked` | list of state fields | stateful component | none | State fields only the server writes (actions, init, hooks); a client $set, $toggle, $reset or brick:model on one is refused. | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.log` | bool, or `debug` · `info` · `warn` · `error` | stateful component | the logger's default | Action logging for this component: false stops logging its successful actions (a failed or refused one is still logged), a level (debug, info, warn, error) sets the level they log at; true or unset keeps the logger's default. | [The guide](../guide.md#state-that-survives-a-restart--brick_secret) |
| `brick.messages` | map of text | stateful component | each rule's own message | Validation messages, "path.rule" → text, overriding a declared rule's default message. | [The guide](../guide.md#validation--rules-declared-once) |
| `brick.model` | text | stateful component | none | The state field this stateful component exposes as its model: a parent binds a field of its own to it with &lt;Child brick:model="field"&gt;. | [The guide](../guide.md#events-and-effects--components-talking-to-each-other) |
| `brick.on` | map of text | stateful component | none | Events this stateful component listens to, event name → action ($refresh, a function, or name(args)). | [The guide](../guide.md#events-and-effects--components-talking-to-each-other) |
| `brick.params` | script function (`fn` or `ns.fn`) | stateful component | none | Script function that runs when the URL sets the component's query: fields: on instance creation and on a patch link or Back/Forward (fn or ns.fn). | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.paths` | text | page | none | Site layer, dynamic pages: the script function listing the values of the [param] segments (posts.slugs). | [The guide](../guide.md#a-whole-site--urls-serving-building) |
| `brick.per_request` | bool | page | `false` | Site layer: true renders this page on every request instead of from the page cache, so its loaders and body see the visitor (site.Options.Request); brick build skips it with a warning. | [The guide](../guide.md#a-whole-site--urls-serving-building) |
| `brick.query` | list of text, or map of map of settings | stateful component | none | State fields synced with URL parameters: a list ([page, q]) or field → {as, history, keep}. | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.remember` | list of state fields | stateful component | none | State fields kept per session beyond an instance's life (needs Options.Remember). | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.rules` | map of (text, or map, or list of (text, or map)) | stateful component | none | Field validation, state path → rule or list of rules; a rule is a name (required) or a one-key map ({min: 2}); a * segment covers every list item (todos.*.title). | [The guide](../guide.md#validation--rules-declared-once) |
| `brick.sitemap` | bool | page | `true` | Site layer: false leaves this page out of the built-in sitemap.xml. | [The guide](../guide.md#the-sitemap) |
| `brick.slots` | map of map of settings | component | none (any block is accepted) | The blocks this component takes, name → {required, doc, examples} (or bare for an optional one). children names the call's body. | [Children, blocks and slots](../guides/components/slots.md) |
| `brick.store` | text | stateful component | the default store (`Options.States`) | The named state store this stateful component uses (default store when unset). Checked against the engine's stores at compile. | [The guide](../guide.md#state-that-survives-a-restart--brick_secret) |
| `brick.temporary` | list of state fields | stateful component | none | State fields rendered with their new value and then reset to the declared one before the instance is saved. | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.updated` | script function (`fn` or `ns.fn`) | stateful component | none | Script function that normalizes fields after a built-in action changed them (fn or ns.fn). | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |
| `brick.uploads` | map of map of settings | stateful component | none | State fields that take files, field → limits {accept, max_size, max_files}. | [The guide](../guide.md#uploads--files-into-state-bytes-into-your-storage) |
| `brick.url` | text | page | the file's path | Site layer: this page's URL, a path starting with / (overrides the one its file path gives). | [The guide](../guide.md#a-whole-site--urls-serving-building) |
| `brick.writable` | list of state fields | stateful component | none | The state fields the client may write when the state is closed; listing it closes this component by itself. An empty list makes every field server-only. | [The guide](../guide.md#server-state--replies-first-values-the-url-and-memory) |

## Prop declaration settings

A prop is declared bare (`title: string`) or as a map of these settings (`tone: {type: string, default: plain, oneof: [plain, loud]}`). `children` and `key` are reserved names.

| Key | Value | Applies to | Default | What it does | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `props.<name>.client` | bool | prop | `false` | true sends the prop to the browser for the component's mount script. | [Styles and client code](../guides/components/styles-and-client.md) |
| `props.<name>.default` | any value | prop | none | The value used when a call does not pass the prop; converted to the declared type. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.doc` | text | prop | none | Documentation for brick docs; rendering never reads it. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.examples` | list of examples | prop | none | Example values or call snippets for brick docs. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.fields` | map of type name or field declaration | `type: map` prop | none | type: map only: the shape of the map, field name → a type or {type, required, oneof, doc, examples, fields, of}. brick check warns on a read of an unlisted field and on a literal that does not fit; rendering never reads it. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.of` | type name or field declaration | `type: list` or `map` prop | none | type: list: the element declaration; type: map: the value under any key. A type or a field declaration. Checked by brick check only. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.oneof` | list | prop | none | The only values the prop accepts. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.reactive` | bool | prop of a stateful component | `false` | Stateful components only: re-render, state kept, when a parent passes a different value. | [The guide](../guide.md#actions--a-button-that-changes-server-state) |
| `props.<name>.required` | bool | prop | `false` | true makes a call that omits the prop (and has no default) an error. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |
| `props.<name>.type` | `string` · `int` · `float` · `bool` · `list` · `map` · `any`, or text | prop | `any` | The prop's type: a built-in one or one the host adds with Options.PropTypes. | [Components and props](../guides/components/props.md) |

## Slot declaration settings

Under `brick: {slots: {<name>: …}}`. A slot written bare (`footer:`) is optional. `children` names the content between the tags.

| Key | Value | Applies to | Default | What it does | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brick.slots.<name>.doc` | text | slot | none | Documentation for brick docs. | [Children, blocks and slots](../guides/components/slots.md) |
| `brick.slots.<name>.examples` | list of examples | slot | none | Example blocks for brick docs. | [Children, blocks and slots](../guides/components/slots.md) |
| `brick.slots.<name>.required` | bool | slot | `false` | true makes a call that does not pass this block an error. | [Children, blocks and slots](../guides/components/slots.md) |
